name: Japan Apartment Rent Benchmarks
license: Derived benchmark metadata for in-app guidance; verify upstream source terms before redistribution
description: City-specific long-term apartment-rent benchmarks for Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto. This dataset is intentionally limited to apartment rentals and excludes detached-house rentals, temporary stays, and hotel-style accommodation.
preprocessing: Built a compact benchmark dataset from current Japan city rent guides already cited by NestGPT
Kept only one-bedroom apartment-style monthly rent benchmarks for supported cities
Excluded house rentals, short-term stays, and non-residential inventory
Stored a small prompt-sized sample with notes and upstream source URLs per record
